symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1610 (ako/mxcli#1538, item 1 of saingge's comment on mendixlabs/mxcli#1517): under `mdl 1;` a re-run `create or modify microflow` whose only change is an `@caption` added to (or reworded on) an existing `if` is refused: 'the If at (360, 200) changes where its paths end or meet — a branch's return, or its else, is added or taken away … [MDL-V1-REBUILD]'. Nothing about the paths changed
cause: patchDiff.gap pairs a declared `if` with the stored one by sameIfShell (whole shell equal, annotations included) or ifConditionChanged (condition differs, rest of the shell equal). A caption-only change fails both, so it fell through to the catch-all that refuses any same-condition `if` as a path-shape change — the message names the last check reached, not the property that differed
fix: ifConditionChanged also accepts the same `if` with another caption (compared with the caption taken out of both shells). conditionEdit states a changed caption on the operation's `if`, and splitCondition writes it through the existing in-place SetCondition: the stated caption, or the condition when the caption is taken off (what the builder writes for a decision with no @caption)
test: mdl/executor/flow_splice_decision_caption_pedapp_test.go TestCreateOrModify_DecisionCaptionIsSetInPlace (caption added, reworded, changed with the condition, taken off; decision keeps its $ID, nothing moves, re-run Unchanged; control: a branch's return taken away is still refused and writes nothing). Before the fix every subtest failed with 'changes where its paths end or meet' (caption + condition together failed with 'cannot replace the ExclusiveSplit')
insight: When a refusal names a reason the user can see is false, look for a catch-all: the gap() refusals are a sequence of shape tests and the last one words every leftover difference as its own. The fix was to widen the edit that already existed (SetCondition sets Caption too), not to add an operation. A guard with a caption (`@caption …` on `if … then return; end if;`) goes through canonicalFlow first and is fixed by the same change
